#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class FastReader {
public:
    FastReader() : reader(cin.rdbuf()) {}

    string next() {
        string s;
        if (!(cin >> s)) throw runtime_error("No more tokens");
        return s;
    }

    string nextLine() {
        string s;
        getline(cin, s);
        return s;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int x;
        if (!(cin >> x)) throw runtime_error("Invalid integer");
        return x;
    }
private:
    istream& reader;
};

class TaskB {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, FastReader& in, ostream& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        string str = in.nextLine();
        if (n <= 0) {
            out << "0 0";
            return;
        }

        string s = str.substr(0, n);
        int len = s.length();
        int pos = 0;
        bool inside = false;
        int curLen = 0;
        int insideWords = 0;
        int maxLen = 0;

        while (pos < len) {
            int next = len;
            int t = s.find('_', pos);
            if (t != -1 && t < next) next = t;
            t = s.find('(', pos);
            if (t != -1 && t < next) next = t;
            t = s.find(')', pos);
            if (t != -1 && t < next) next = t;

            if (pos < next) {
                curLen = next - pos;
                if (inside) insideWords++;
                else if (curLen > maxLen) maxLen = curLen;
                curLen = 0;
            }

            if (next < len) {
                char c = s.at(next);
                if (c == '(') inside = true;
                else if (c == ')') inside = false;
                pos = next + 1;
            } else {
                pos = len;
            }
        }

        out << maxLen << " " << insideWords;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    FastReader in;
    TaskB solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, cout);
    return 0;
}
